wizard.title: Setup
wizard.resumed: Picked up where you left off.
wizard.skipRestHint: Go straight to the last step. Anything skipped can be set up later in Settings.

stepNote.ok: This step is done. Continue when you're ready.

language.name: Language
language.title: Welcome to {{appName}}
language.description: Choose the interface language first. The next steps set up the AI model, speech recognition and translation. Every step can be skipped and changed later in Settings.
language.label: Interface language
language.appliesNow: Applies right away, in every window.

overview.llm: Connect the AI model behind answers, summaries and translation.
overview.stt: Choose how you and the other side are transcribed.
overview.translation: Decide whether captions are translated, and by whom.
overview.audio: Check that your microphone and the other side's audio come through.

llm.name: AI model
llm.title: Connect an AI model
llm.description: The model answers questions, writes meeting summaries and can translate. This step is done when a test request succeeds.

stt.name: Speech recognition
stt.title: Set up speech recognition
stt.description: Choose an engine and a language for you and for the other side. This step is done when the engine passes its test.

translation.name: Translation
translation.title: Set up translation
translation.description: Choose whether captions are translated, which side, into which language and by which service.

audio.name: Audio check
audio.title: Audio Setup
audio.description: Choose audio sources for you and the other party, then check that both are heard.

micTest.title: Microphone Test
micTest.speakNow: Speak now to verify your microphone...
micTest.idle: Click "Test Audio" and speak to check
micTest.silent: No sound came from the microphone.

systemTest.title: System Audio Test
systemTest.playNow: Play something now (a video or music) and keep it playing...
systemTest.idle: Start playing a video or music, then click "Test Audio"
systemTest.detected: The other side's audio comes through.

help.title: What to check
help.micDevice: The source above is the microphone you are using.
help.micPermission: {{appName}} is allowed to use the microphone: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
help.micPermissionWindows: Desktop apps are allowed to use the microphone: Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone.
help.systemPlaying: Sound was playing during the test, through the output device chosen above.
help.systemPermission: {{appName}} is allowed to record system audio: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording (macOS 14.2 or later).

problems.system: No system audio from the other side.

finish.name: Finish
finish.title: Review your setup
finish.description: Here is where each step stands. Go back to any step, or change things later in Settings.

check.title: Before your first meeting
check.hint: Can speech recognition run as it is set up? Checked from the settings: engine, API key, local model.
check.tested: Speech recognition passed its test in step 3.
check.blocked: Neither side's speech recognition can run yet, so a meeting would have no captions. Set up an engine first, or go to the launcher for now.

knowledgeBase.title: Personal knowledge base
knowledgeBase.hint: Upload your resume, a job description or notes. The AI draws on them for more personal answers.

rerun.label: First-run setup
rerun.hint: Go through the language, AI model, speech recognition, translation and audio check again. Opens right away; your settings are kept.
rerun.inMeeting: Available once the meeting has ended.
